name: corrcov
expr: [R, sigma] = corrcov(C); R2 = corrcov(C2); [Re, se] = corrcov(eye(3)); [Rs, ss] = corrcov(5);
comment: MATLAB corrcov: R = C ./ sqrt(diag(C)*diag(C)'); sigma = sqrt(diag(C))'. Bit-equal with MATLAB R2025b on 3x3 covariance, identity, scalar, and negative-correlation 2x2 cases. Octave 11.1.0 doesn't ship corrcov in core (statistics package only); reports N/A.
